sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (refer policy schedule)

room_rent.display: Single Private Room (0% copay); Deluxe/Suite attract copay
room_rent.note: Select: All room categories except Deluxe and Suite = 0% copay; All room categories (incl. Deluxe/Suite) = 0% copay per Annexure V rows — actually Select rows show: 'All Room Categories except deluxe and Suite' = 0%, 'All Room Categories' = 0%, 'General Ward' = 20%, 'Twin Sharing Room' = 40%. This implies eligible room is Single Private Room; downgrading to General Ward or Twin Sharing triggers copay.

icu.note: No specific ICU sub-limit mentioned for Select; covered up to Sum Insured.

copayment.display: None (if Single Private Room or above chosen); General Ward 20%, Twin Sharing 40%
copayment.note: Mandatory copay only if insured chooses a room below eligible category (General Ward 20%, Twin Sharing 40%). No mandatory copay on admissible claim otherwise. HeadsUp/Tiered Network non-compliance triggers 20% copay.

sub_limits.display: Cataract: Mono-focal lens only; Modern treatments sub-limited
sub_limits.note: Select variant covers only Mono-focal Lens for cataract. Modern treatments have a sub-limit (can be removed via optional Modern Treatments+ add-on).

deductible.note: No inbuilt deductible. Optional Annual Aggregate Deductible can be opted.

initial_waiting.note: Can be reduced via optional Initial Wait Period Modification add-on.

ped_waiting.note: Can be reduced or increased via optional Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Time Modification.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Same list as Classic. Can be modified via optional Specific Disease Waiting Time Modification.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are a standard exclusion (Excl18). No inbuilt or optional maternity benefit described for Select variant.

cumulative_bonus.note: Same Booster+ mechanism as Classic. Unutilised Base SI accumulates up to 10x Base SI.

restoration.note: Same as Classic. ReAssure Forever triggers after first paid claim, unlimited resets up to Base SI per claim.

pre_hosp.note: Can be modified via optional Pre-Hospitalisation Modification add-on.

post_hosp.note: Can be modified via optional Post-Hospitalisation Modification add-on.

ambulance.display: Road: up to policy limit; Air: emergency only
ambulance.note: Air Ambulance+ add-on available for Select to enhance air ambulance limit.

modern_treatments.note: Same 12 modern treatments as Classic, covered up to plan sub-limit. Modern Treatments+ add-on available for Select.

notable_exclusions: Dental (non-accident), external congenital anomaly, infertility/ART, refractive error <7.5D, conflict/war/terrorism, brain death life support, off-label drug use
optional_riders: Claim Safeguard+, Borderless, Borderless for Specific Illness, International Cover, Modern Treatments+, Air Ambulance+, Personal Accident (Lite/PA/Pro), Hospital Daily Cash, WellConsult+, NivaBupaOne, Cash-Bag+, Critical Illness, HeadsUp, Tiered Network
